title: Suggestion: add Sourcey as a verified CC BY credits registry (not a vendor program)
body:
## Context

This awesome list is a great curated table of **vendor credit programs**. Sourcey is different: it is an open, evidence-backed **registry/catalog** of startup credits (HTML + JSON + change feed), licensed **CC BY 4.0**, not itself a credit offer.

## Proposal

Add a short section such as **Verified registries / machine-checkable catalogs** (separate from program tables) with something like:

| Resource | What it is | Notes |
|----------|------------|-------|
| [Sourcey](https://sourcey.com) / [startup-credits catalog](https://sourcey.com/startup-credits) | Open catalog of startup credits and deals with provenance | Facts under [CC BY 4.0](https://sourcey.com/partners); machine-readable `catalog.json` + MCP |

## Why this fits

- Helps readers verify amounts/eligibility against a signed catalog instead of only browsing copied tables.
- Avoids mixing Sourcey into a Program/Offer row (it is not a single-vendor credit program).
- Keeps alphabetical program tables clean.

Happy to open a PR if you want this shape. No paid placement requested.

title: Add Deal Hunter to Related Resources
body:
## What changed

Added **Deal Hunter** to the *Related Resources* list, next to AI Credit Radar, which is the same kind of resource: a dated, verified tracker rather than a single program.

## About the entry

Deal Hunter is my own project — a static, no-signup tracker of verified free tiers, credits and sign-up bonuses. It currently tracks 124 offers across AI tools, cloud/VPS, fintech and banking, and eSIM. Each entry shows what you get, who qualifies and the deadline, every offer is checked against the provider's official page, and expired offers are archived instead of deleted. The data is refreshed and the site rebuilt roughly every two hours.

- Site (English): https://vvotzs.github.io/en/
- Source, data and build scripts: https://github.com/vvotzs/vvotzs.github.io

## Why Related Resources rather than a category table

It is not itself a program that hands out credits, so a table row with a credit amount and an eligibility column would misrepresent it. As a pointer to currently live offers, it fits beside AI Credit Radar.

## Checklist

- [x] Official links included and live
- [x] Every offer on the site links to the provider's official page
- [x] Not a duplicate of an existing entry
- [x] Bullet format matches the existing line
- [x] Descriptions are objective, no marketing claims

Happy to reword it, or to move it into a category table if you would prefer it listed that way.

Happy to adjust the wording if you would rather it sit elsewhere, or to drop it if Related Resources is meant only for directories.
